name: Signal Amplifier - Retaliation
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Retaliation capability.

61179.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Retaliation
61179.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
When Retaliating, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
